goal: Implement director-grade controls for scoped context grants and 5-hour token-window budget tracking.
objective: Build the first production-ready contract for giving remote agents only the missing scoped information they need, and for tracking the local director token budget as a 5-hour window where 100% is the full available period. Prefer Control Plane/Fabric API surfaces and Control Center-readable status. Keep Mac-local access under owner/director control; remote nodes must never receive broad Mac/session/secret access.
implementation_requirements: Add or update a Control Plane contract for scoped context grants with grant_id, task_id, receiver, purpose, allowed_use, forbidden_use, expiry, data_classification and redaction status.
Add owner-safe status reporting for active/revoked/expired grants without exposing secrets.
Add a token-window status contract for a 5-hour local director window with percent_used, band, estimated_reset_at, checkpoint_required and remote_first_required fields.
When exact platform token percentage is unavailable, support approximate/manual input and thread-counter evidence without pretending it is exact.
Expose contracts in a way that the future Control Center wall panel can render them.
Add focused tests for schema, redaction and band transitions.
Do not touch live Telegram receiver ownership, tokens, provider billing, server deletion or production service restarts.
acceptance: The repository contains a machine-readable scoped grant contract and tests.
Remote agents can request missing context without receiving full Mac/session/secret access.
The director can issue a one-shot or expiring non-secret grant and audit it.
The 5-hour token-window policy is represented as a status contract with green/yellow/orange/red bands.
Control Center can read the token-window and grant status contract without secret exposure.
Tests prove redaction and token band transitions.
Exact PLAN/ACTIONS/TESTS/RESULT/NEXT artifacts are created under the required run directory.
No live Telegram, billing, provider, secret or destructive action is performed.
